claims.text:
6. gaussian-mixture-em

Target / packet: ai-gaussian-mixture-em · P3. Prerequisites: ai:k-means-clustering.

Nearest / distinct payoff: k-means-clustering → bad-start-kmeans. Hard nearest-centroid labels differ from fractional Gaussian component responsibilities and their weighted mean update.

Finite primary model: 1D points [0,2], two Gaussian components means 0,2, equal weights and variance 1 fixed. Let r=sigmoid(2). At point0 responsibilities are[r,1-r]; at point2 they reverse. M-step means become[2(1-r),2r]≈[.238406,1.761594].

Countercase and mathematical boundary: Coincident means 1,1 give equal responsibilities and stay 1,1. This is one EM step updating means/mixing weights only, not covariance fitting or convergence/global-optimum proof.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict whether each point belongs exclusively to one component; recall equal-initial-means collapse and distinguish soft responsibility from hard assignment.

Required observable evidence: Expose responsibility weights and weighted mean contribution for each component; do not silently substitute k-means assignments.

Source obligation: [scikit-learn Gaussian-mixture documentation](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/mixture.html), acquired method body §2.1.1. Locally fixed variances and one mean-update step must be distinguished from fitting a complete covariance model.
 Shipped local model and displayed expression addresses: model.ts compute; Demo.tsx Figure; Stage retained computed witnesses.
